dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: I remember one of the ships was a tea clipper from Liyue, and the other was carrying spices from Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Speaking of tea, I've heard that there's a delicacy in Liyue where they boil a bird's egg and then crack part of the shell.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Once they've done that, they soak it in tea along with various seasonings. The egg absorbs the aroma of the tea and produces a unique and layered flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: I wonder if there are any clever minds in Fontaine that can replicate this delicacy. I'd really like to taste it.
